parsed.main_gap: Lemma 2, the essential descent connecting arbitrary minimal supports to bounded-size ones, is asserted without proof.

errors.description: Lemma 2 is the core of the finiteness argument: without its claimed weight descent, there is no reason all primes occurring in minimal supports lie in finitely many terminal members. Calling it standard does not supply the required argument.
errors.quote: This follows by a descent on the weight $w$ (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: The support reformulation, self-duality, sunflower lemma, and deduction of periodicity from finiteness of the minimal supports are otherwise coherent. The omitted lemma is substantial rather than a routine detail.
